verdict.rationale: Discord provides extensive first-party documentation for building against official SDKs and APIs — the REST API, Gateway (WebSocket) API, OAuth2, Embedded App SDK, and a full Discord Social SDK with platform-specific guides for Unity, Unreal Engine, C++, iOS/Android, and web/mobile account linking. This gives builders (including AI-native developers) clear, well-documented interfaces to build bots, apps, and integrations. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on developer corroboration of SDK integration experience and AI-agent-specific SDK examples or tooling.
